text: FAB.Group / speed-dial actions: The FAB and its 'Receipt'/'Mileage' actions are anchored to the top-right and overlap the first list card, hiding the 'Job site visit' label — it reads as broken. Expected after the fix: Wrap the FAB in a container with position:'absolute', right:16, bottom: tabBarHeight + 16 (use useBottomTabBarHeight() or insets.bottom + 72), left:'auto', top:'auto', zIndex:2. Use Paper <FAB.Group open visible icon="plus" fabStyle={{ marginBottom: 0 }} /> so the mini-FABs stack upward from the bottom-right, and add a 96px bottom padding to the list contentContainerStyle so con

Bottom tab bar: Tab labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) are cut off at the bottom edge on phone and sit tight on desktop — no safe-area inset. Expected after the fix: In the Tab.Navigator screenOptions set tabBarStyle={{ height: 56 + insets.bottom, paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 8, paddingTop: 8 }} and tabBarLabelStyle={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 16, marginTop: 2 }} using useSafeAreaInsets().

Screen container / header: The 'Mileage' title touches the top of the viewport and uses a 32px left inset while the rest of the app uses 16px, so nothing lines up. Expected after the fix: Create/apply a shared <Screen> component: SafeAreaView edges={['top']} + View with paddingHorizontal:16, paddingTop:16, gap:16. Render the title as <Text variant="headlineSmall"> (not an oversized bold heading) so all screens share one header rhythm.

Content width on desktop: At 1280x800 the content is a narrow 390px column with a huge empty field below, so the desktop view looks unfinished. Expected after the fix: In the shared <Screen>, give the inner content View style={{ width:'100%', maxWidth: 720, alignSelf:'center' }} and paddingHorizontal: 24 at >=900px width.

Mileage list row: Row is a custom card with a right-aligned 'Job site visit' that collides with the FAB and a redundant 'Date:' prefix; hierarchy is unclear. Expected after the fix: Replace with Paper <List.Item title="Job site visit" (titleNumberOfLines={1}) description="30 mi · Nov 12, 2026" right={() => <Text variant="titleMedium">30 mi</Text>} /> inside a single <Card mode="outlined">, titleMedium / bodyMedium with onSurfaceVariant for the description. Drop the 'Date:' label and format dates as 'Nov 12, 2026'.

Empty/under-filled list area: Below the single row there is ~1200px of blank surface with no guidance, so the screen looks empty and dead. Expected after the fix: When the list has 0 items render the shared <EmptyState> (illustration, title 'No trips yet', description 'Log your first drive to track mileage deductions.', Button mode="contained" 'Add mileage') centered with flex:1; when it has items, add a 'Recent trips' <Text variant="titleSmall" color onSurfaceVariant> section label above the card with 8px bottom margin.

Card elevation/shape in theme: Cards use a heavy drop shadow and ~24px radius that fights MD3 and makes the single row look like a floating dialog. Expected after the fix: In src/theme.ts set roundness: 3 (12px) and use Card mode="outlined" by default in the shared card wrapper (backgroundColor: colors.surface, borderColor: colors.outlineVariant, elevation 0).
